name: message
description: A source-owned chat message row (Message/MessageAvatar/MessageHeader/MessageContent/MessageFooter/MessageGroup), aligned to the sent or received edge.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational; no dedicated primitive dependency (task 10.1's own audit). Typically composes the sibling Avatar registry item for MessageAvatar and the sibling Bubble registry item for MessageContent.
documentation.accessibility: Renders as plain div content with no assigned role; conversational semantics come from the surrounding document structure, matching upstream's own lack of a dedicated ARIA pattern for chat messages (registry/ui/message.rs).
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; not an interactive control.
